records.text: Keeper Albagorm is a protector of the forest spirits, alarmed by the destruction of the Charred Vale and the Bloodfury harpies blocking efforts to restore it. He charges visitors with driving the harpies out, then asks them to carry word of the forest's need for aid to the druid Falfindel Waywarder. His concern is the land's recovery, which he sees as work that can begin once the harpies are subdued.

records.text: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil is an old friend of Darsok and remembers Rokhan's role in an earlier fight against the Bloodfeathers. At Malaka'jin, he proposes a cruel scheme for three captured elves: a concoction he calls forest magic, made from animal parts. His gleeful talk of cages and brewing, followed by mocking laughter as he works, shows a deliberate, taunting attitude toward the captives and nature. He is pleased to hear the Bloodfeathers are dead, recalling the old conflict without claiming knowledge beyond what Darsok's letter reports.
